name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access; HEU kept as red line
summary: Iran's foreign minister calls keeping its enriched uranium a red line; Trump says Iran's terms are unacceptable
state: Foreign Minister Araghchi said keeping Iran's highly enriched uranium in the country is a red line while claiming a fair solution with the US can be reached (Times of Israel, 21 Nov). On 20 Nov Trump said Iran's terms for ending the war were unacceptable (US News/Reuters). Normal IAEA inspections have not resumed. No strike on a nuclear site or NPT withdrawal was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: No direct effect on the public outside the region. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf.
rubric_hit: Enrichment at 60%, inspector access curtailed = Watch

sources.title: Times of Israel — Iran's FM sets red line on enriched uranium
US News (Reuters) — Araqchi says Iran wants diplomacy to end war, Trump says terms unacceptable

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
